shared_elements: quadruped animal shown in profile with four legs
long horizontal element bearing a row of short repeated vertical strokes (comb/fringe-like band)
schematic animals rendered in silhouette or flat relief
small figure(s) placed above the horizontal band
justification: The clearest correspondence is formal rather than iconographic: both surfaces carry a long horizontal element fringed with a row of short repeated strokes, with a small profile quadruped placed just above it. Otherwise the content diverges sharply — A shows a stacked composition of raptor-like birds, a snarling carnivore, a snake-like form and a human-like figure in modelled relief, while B shows a single flat-silhouette manned boat with a crescent prow and human legs, with no birds, snakes or anthropomorphic relief figures.
